description: Held-out companion accuracy set (60 questions), written blind to the companion implementation and to questions.json. Phrasing imitates real player chat (slang, abbreviations, typos, roleplay, buried questions). Ground truth comes only from the repo's WoW Forever data packs (build 1.60.1); every mustInclude/anyOf fact is cited in evidence. Coordinates are percent (x*100) with one decimal, averaged over the record's positions on its first map; the benchmark matches coordinates within 0.6. Faction balance by theme: 29 Horde (26 Horde profiles + 3 'none' about Horde/Barrens/Ashenvale content), 29 Alliance (25 Alliance profiles + 4 'none' about Alliance content), 2 neutral (off-topic refusal, Onyxia roleplay).
